title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Ambient Komercial, Buze Rruge!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna Parisit, ne rrugen "Medar Shtylla", shitet Ambient Komercial, ne katin e pare ne nje pallat te vitit 2002, me ashensor dhe i mireadministruar. Ambjenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 149 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne kater ambiente, tre ballkone dhe dy tualete. Ne ambient eshte instaluar sistemi chiller per ftohje dhe sistemi i kaldajes per ngrohje. Duhet theksuar qe ne ambjent egziston mundesia qe te nxirren dhe shkalle nga jashte, pervec hyrjes kryesore qe ka aktualisht. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ambienti si dhe location buze rruge, e bene nje nder zonat me te preferuara per investim pasi te ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme. Ambienti ka dhe nje garazh te mbyllur prej 24 m2, i cili eshte me cmim extra prej 25.000 euro. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: At the Municipality of Paris, Commercial Space for Sale, Street Side!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, on "Medar Shtylla" street, Commercial Space is for sale, on the first floor in a building of 2002, with an elevator and well managed. The space has a surface of 149 m2 and is organized in four rooms, three balconies and two toilets. A chiller system for cooling and a boiler system for heating have been installed in the premises. It should be noted that in the area there is the possibility to take out stairs from the outside, in addition to the main entrance that is currently there. The area in which the environment is located, as well as the roadside location, make it one of the most preferred areas for investment as it offers all the necessary facilities. The environment also has a closed garage of 24 m2, which has an extra price of 25,000 euros. The property has full mortgage documentation.
